text_en: The king’s heart is a stream of water in the hand of the Lord ; he turns it wherever he will.
text_cn: 君王的心在上主的手里，有如水流，可随意转移。

text_en: All deeds are right in the sight of the doer, but the Lord weighs the heart.
text_cn: 人对自己的行为，都自觉正直；但审察人心的，却是上主。

text_en: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
text_cn: 秉公行义，比献祭献更悦上主。

text_en: Haughty eyes and a proud heart— the lamp of the wicked—are sin.
text_cn: 傲慢的眼睛，骄矜的心灵，恶人的炫耀，无非是罪恶。

text_en: The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance, but everyone who is hasty comes only to want.
text_cn: 熟思的人，必足以致富；草率的人，必贫困缠身。

text_en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a snare of death.
text_cn: 以谎言伪语骗得的财宝，是浮云轻烟，死亡的罗网。

text_en: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away, because they refuse to do what is just.
text_cn: 恶人的暴戾，必殃及自身，因他们不肯去履行正义。

text_en: The way of the guilty is crooked, but the conduct of the pure is right.
text_cn: 恶人的道路，歪曲邪僻；正人的行为，正直适中。

text_en: It is better to live in a corner of the housetop than in a house shared with a contentious wife.
text_cn: 宁愿住在屋顶的一角，不愿与吵妇同居一室。

text_en: The souls of the wicked desire evil; their neighbors find no mercy in their eyes.
text_cn: 恶人的心灵，只求邪恶；对自己友伴，毫不关怀。

text_en: When a scoffer is punished, the simple become wiser; when the wise are instructed, they increase in knowledge.
text_cn: 轻狂人遭受处罚，幼稚者将得明智；智慧人接受教训，更增加自己知识。

text_en: The Righteous One observes the house of the wicked; he casts the wicked down to ruin.
text_cn: 正义的上主监视恶人的家，且使恶人们都陷于灾祸中。

text_en: If you close your ear to the cry of the poor, you will cry out and not be heard.
text_cn: 谁对穷人的哀求，充耳不闻，他呼求时，也不会得到应允。

text_en: A gift in secret averts anger; and a concealed bribe in the bosom, strong wrath.
text_cn: 暗中相送的馈赠，可平息忿怒；投入怀中的礼物，可平息狂怒。

text_en: When justice is done, it is a joy to the righteous, but dismay to evildoers.
text_cn: 秉公行义，能叫义人喜乐；但为作恶的人，却是恐惧。

text_en: Whoever wanders from the way of understanding will rest in the assembly of the dead.
text_cn: 凡远离明智道路的人，必居于幽灵的集会中。

text_en: Whoever loves pleasure will suffer want; whoever loves wine and oil will not be rich.
text_cn: 贪爱享乐的人，必遭受穷困；喜爱酒油的人，必不会致富。

text_en: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, and the faithless for the upright.
text_cn: 恶人必将为义人作赎金，败类也将替君子作代价。

text_en: It is better to live in a desert land than with a contentious and fretful wife.
text_cn: 与好争易怒的女人同居，倒不如独自住在旷野里。

text_en: Precious treasure remains in the house of the wise, but the fool devours it.
text_cn: 珍贵的宝藏和油，积藏在智者家里；但糊涂愚昧的人，却将之消耗净尽。

text_en: Whoever pursues righteousness and kindness will find life and honor.
text_cn: 追求正义和仁慈的人，必将获得生命与尊荣。

text_en: One wise person went up against a city of warriors and brought down the stronghold in which they trusted.
text_cn: 智者必登上勇士的城邑，攻破城邑所凭倚的堡垒。

text_en: To watch over mouth and tongue is to keep out of trouble.
text_cn: 谁谨守自己的口舌，心灵必能免受烦恼。

text_en: The proud, haughty person, named “Scoffer, ” acts with arrogant pride.
text_cn: 高傲的人名叫“狂人”，他行事必极端蛮横。

text_en: The craving of the lazy person is fatal, for lazy hands refuse to labor.
text_cn: 怠惰(dài duò)人的手不肯操作，必为他的愿望所扼杀。

text_en: All day long the wicked covet, but the righteous give and do not hold back.
text_cn: 贪婪的人，终日贪婪；正义的人，广施不吝。

text_en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; how much more when brought with evil intent.
text_cn: 恶人的祭献，已是可憎；若怀恶而献，更将如何？

text_en: A false witness will perish, but a good listener will testify successfully.
text_cn: 作假见证的人，必要灭亡；但善于听的人，才可常言。

text_en: The wicked put on a bold face, but the upright give thought to their ways.
text_cn: 邪恶的人，常装腔作势；正直的人，却举止检点。

text_en: No wisdom, no understanding, no counsel, can avail against the Lord .
text_cn: 任何智慧、才略或计谋，都不能与上主相对抗。

text_en: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but the victory belongs to the Lord .
text_cn: 招兵买马，是为作战之日；但是胜利，却由上主指使。
